about: Validator-side additions merged after data/read_fields.json (a verbatim copy of C:/RC_RE/research/read_fields.json): fix hints, and interim rules the research table does not carry yet. Drop an entry here once the research table carries it. See library/validator.md 'Present but ignored'. keepWarning: keep RC072 at warning even when retail carries the key (data/retail_ignored_counts.json).

bodyFriction.fixHint: set prop_truck_friction_updater.frictionMaterialsList.<material>.frictionValue (the friction updater writes it into wheel.bodyFriction at wheel start and on every material change)

substanceFriction.why: runtime field: prop_truck_friction_updater.Init replaces the wheel's substanceFriction with frictionMaterialsList.default.substanceFriction (0.5 when unset)

spring.fixHint: move `spring` to a tpl_markup_spring_motor {spring, damping} (it reads only those two: default 0, unlimited force)

tau.fixHint: drop it, or use a tpl_markup_position_motor if a tau-driven motor was meant; a spring motor reads only spring and damping

maxForce.fixHint: drop it: a spring motor's force is unlimited (FLT_MAX); it reads only spring and damping

proportionalRecoveryVelocity.fixHint: drop it: a spring motor reads only spring and damping

constantRecoveryVelocity.fixHint: drop it: a spring motor reads only spring and damping

spreadAngle.fixHint: spreadAngle is only read under TrackParticleMaterialSettings; WheelParticleMaterialSettings uses spreadAngleProb

lowRangeMultiplier.fixHint: lowRangeMultiplier is read by nothing (retail carries it dead); low range is lowRangeGear (set lowRangeGear.angularVelocity for the speed cap)

.tpl_markup::tpl_markup_object_property_.fixHint: set massFromDensity = False to use mass (the default True uses density, 600)
remove density, or set massFromDensity = True if the density was meant
set havokMassCenter = False to use boneCenterOfMassOffset, or use hkCenterOfMassOffset
set havokMassCenter = True to use hkCenterOfMassOffset, or use boneCenterOfMassOffset

.tpl_markup::tpl_markup_constraint.fixHint: set isBreakable = True if the joint is meant to break, else remove breakThreshold
set isMalleable = True if the joint is meant to be soft, else remove malleableStrength

.tpl_markup::tpl_markup_constraint_hinge.fixHint: set limited = True if the angles are meant as stops, else remove them (unlimited hinges use +-1e14)
set limited = True if the angles are meant as stops, else remove them (unlimited hinges use +-1e14)

.tpl_markup::tpl_markup_constraint_prism.fixHint: set isMinLimit = True if the stop is meant, else remove minLimit
set isMaxLimit = True if the stop is meant, else remove maxLimit
